Tools

Understanding how tissues bend, fold and rearrange during development requires bridging two worlds that rarely talk to each other: the microscope and the mathematical model. These three open-source tools form a continuous pipeline that does exactly that — starting from raw 3D fluorescence images of living tissues, extracting quantitative geometric and mechanical information from every cell, and feeding those measurements into physics-based simulations to test and generate hypotheses about morphogenetic mechanisms. Together they make it possible to go from seeing a tissue deform to understanding why it deforms the way it does.

🔬

DISSECT

Segmentation · Analysis

Addresses the challenge of segmenting and analysing cells in highly curved or deformed 3D epithelia, where conventional tools fail.

Input Fluorescence microscopy (confocal / light-sheet) of the apical surface of 3D epithelial tissues
Output Segmented cell meshes, fluorescence, shape metrics
3D segmentation cell mechanics deformed epithelia
Merle, Theis et al. Developmental Cell 58(20), 2023.
📐

CellMet

Quantification · Topology

A dedicated toolkit for computing 3D shape and topological descriptors of cells packed within tissues. Goes beyond simple volume/area to capture neighbour relationships, curvature, and connectivity.

Input 3D segmented cell meshes
Output Shape metrics (volume, surface, aspect ratio), topology graphs, neighbour statistics
shape metrics topology 3D analysis confluent cells
Theis et al. PLOS Computational Biology 21(7), 2025.
⚙️

Tyssue

Simulation · Library

An open-source Python library for simulating epithelial tissue mechanics. Implements vertex models and energy-based frameworks to simulate cell rearrangements, deformations, and morphogenetic events — parameterisable from experimental measurements.

Input Cell geometry (vertex positions), mechanical parameters (tensions, elasticities)
Output Simulated tissue dynamics, force maps, energy landscapes, deformation trajectories
vertex model epithelial mechanics Python library morphogenesis
Theis, Suzanne & Gay. Journal of Open Source Software 6(62), 2021.
